metadata.title: Commercial spyware vs device forensics; hacktivism and leaks

entities.name: NSO_Group
entities.notes: Pegasus. Entity List. Mercenary zero-click. Unit 8200 alumni reporting.

entities.name: Intellexa
entities.notes: Predator/Cytrox. OFAC 2024; later reporting of designations reversed for some figures (2025) - enforcement-reversal pattern.

entities.name: Paragon
entities.notes: Graphite. Citizen Lab 2025 Italy journalist targeting. AE Industrial / US-friendly framing.

entities.name: Cellebrite
entities.notes: UFED. Physical-custody extraction, not covert implant. Distinct legal/technical class.

entities.name: Circles_SS7
entities.notes: SS7 location/intercept, no implant. Citizen Lab 2020: 25 government customers.

entities.name: Anonymous
entities.notes: A banner, not an org. DDoS/doxxing under a name anyone can fly.

entities.name: WikiLeaks
entities.notes: Vault 7 CIA dump (2017). Distinct from APT attribution of 2016 DNC emails (contested routing).

entities.name: LAPSUS
entities.notes: Helpdesk vishing / MFA-fatigue. Microsoft, Okta, NVIDIA, Uber. CSRB case study. Lineage into The Com / Scattered Spider.

entities.name: Cl0p
entities.notes: TA505. MOVEit 2023 mass data-extortion without always encrypting.

entities.name: DarkSide
entities.notes: Colonial Pipeline 2021. DOJ clawback of part of the Bitcoin ransom - seizable rails.

entities.name: Palantir
entities.notes: Gotham / foundry analytics. CIA-seeded public history. Clear-world data platform used by governments.

entities.name: Clearview_AI
entities.notes: Face search from scraped web images sold to police/agencies. Civil-liberties litigation public.

edges.notes: Protector-for-police; misuse is a separate graded debate.
